description: Report what the x402 world can currently see of a merchant: every resource payable to the merchant's addresses that appears in the CDP x402 Bazaar, plus any self-hosted manifest (/.well-known/x402.json, /.well-known/x402 or an /openapi.json with x-payment-info) on its registered product endpoints' hosts, plus, best-effort, what the x402scan index lists for those addresses (source x402scan, no price). Each item is tagged with its relationship to the merchant's registered products — referral_mode (payment routes through this chain's SplitRouter, so referrals attribute), published (the resource matches a registered product, and product_id is set), or discoverable (visible in the Bazaar but not registered here). This is the answer to 'can buyers and referrer agents find my products?', which check_product_readiness cannot give: that probes ONE endpoint's payment wiring, this shows the whole catalogue as the outside world sees it. pay_tos echoes the addresses that were queried — every wallet that acts for the merchant: its agent wallet and owner, resolved on-chain, and each holder of a merchant role (at most 8), plus any pay_to values passed in (at most 10) for a treasury the resolver would not find. IMPORTANT: a 'throttled' field, when present, names the legs (bazaar, manifest) whose outbound fetches were skipped because the server's discovery budget was momentarily spent. Its presence means the answer is INCOMPLETE — an empty or short item list then says nothing about whether the merchant is listed, so retry rather than concluding it is missing. Unauthenticated: everything returned is already public.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

pay_to.description: Optional extra payTo addresses to query alongside the resolved ones

name: get_merchant_discovery
